c74object.name: evi.biquadcoeff
c74object.digest: Message rate biquad coefficients calculator with selection of 40 different filter types
c74object.description: evi.biquadcoeff is an efficient message rate coefficients calculator for the biquad~ (or evi.biquad~) object. It is intended to replace filtergraph~ for when you do not need a UI or you want to take advantage of the more filter types available. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

inlet.digest: Cutoff in Hz (change units with 'cutoffunits' attribute) / (symbol) Filter
inlet.description: Cutoff in Hz (default) or Pitch (change units with 'cutoffunits' attribute).

inlet.digest: Gain in dB (change units with 'gainunits' attribute)
inlet.description: Gain in dB (default) or linear value (change units with 'gainunits' attribute).
Q of currently selected filter type, typically clamped 0.1..18, but some filter types can take much higher values (e.g. 'reson' or 'bp')

outlet.description: Use outlet 1 as a list OR outlets 2..6 individually.

objarg.name: filter type
objarg.description: A symbol will set the filter type by name, an int will set the filter type by index.

method.name: anything

arg.name: filter type
arg.units: bypass, lowpass, highpass, bandpass, bandstop, peaknotch, lowshelf, lowshelfcookbook, highshelf, highshelfcookbook, resonant, bp, allpass, gainlpass, gainhpass, gainbpass, gainbstop, gainresonant, gainbp, gainapass, lowpassanalog1, lowpassanalog2, highpassanalog, bandpassanalog, gainbpassanalog, notchanalog, peaknotchanalog1, peaknotchanalog2, lowshelfanalog1, lowshelfanalog2, highshelfanalog1, highshelfanalog2, resonantanalog, butterlowpass, butterhighpass, butterbandpass, butterbandreject, buttergainlpass, buttergainhpass, buttergainbpass, buttergainbreject

method.digest: In left inlet, messages to evi.biquadcoeff
method.description: A symbol will set the filter type by name.

attribute.name: cutoffunits
attribute.description: Set the units for the cutoff frequency (inlet 1). 0 = in Hz (default), 1 = in Pitch (e.g. 0..127).

attribute.name: gainunits
attribute.description: Set the units for the gain (inlet 2). 0 = in linear amplitude, 1 = in dB (the default).

c74object.discussion: For a complete list of available filter names or equivalent index number, @see: 'evieve/misc/data/evi.biquadcoeff.filters.txt' or look at the helpfile. For more information about biquads and other filter types in evieve see the 'evieve biquad' tab of the helpfile.
